info.title: CourseFlow V2 API
info.description: OpenAPI is generated from Ninja routes and schemas. Primary CRUD routes return entity fields only. Graph editor loads use 'GET /graph/{uuid}/view' (Graph View payload). See 'course_flow.api.conventions' and 'course_flow.api.schemas.graph_view'.

post.description: Placeholder route: no duplicate project is created (see application service).

post.summary: Mark All My Notifications As Read

ProjectDetailOut.description: Single project resource with minimal child workflow list metadata.
ProjectDetailOut.title: ProjectDetailOut

WorkflowType.description: Root graph workflow semantic layer (``task`` is not a valid root type).
WorkflowType.title: WorkflowType

ProjectListItemOut.description: List rows: compact project fields only.
ProjectListItemOut.title: ProjectListItemOut

ProjectGraphViewOut.description: Project overview: entity fields + graph UUID references only.
ProjectGraphViewOut.title: ProjectGraphViewOut

ProjectDuplicatePlaceholderOut.description: Response for POST /project/{uuid}/duplicate while duplication is not implemented.
ProjectDuplicatePlaceholderOut.title: ProjectDuplicatePlaceholderOut

ProjectTeamMemberAddIn.description: Add one or more users to the project team.
ProjectTeamMemberAddIn.title: ProjectTeamMemberAddIn

SuccessOut.description: Minimal typed body for simple destructive operations (e.g. delete).
SuccessOut.title: SuccessOut

WorkflowCreateIn.description: Create a root ``Workflow`` and its backing ``Graph`` row (1:1 ORM).
WorkflowCreateIn.title: WorkflowCreateIn

WorkflowTypeIn.description: Allowed root graph workflow types (``task`` is only valid on grid nodes).
WorkflowTypeIn.title: WorkflowTypeIn

EdgeGraphOut.description: Endpoints are node UUIDs; ``id`` distinguishes multiple edges between the same pair.
EdgeGraphOut.title: EdgeGraphOut

GraphMetaOut.description: Graph UUID/revision plus root ``Workflow`` fields (graph row has no title/author/project).
GraphMetaOut.title: GraphMetaOut

GraphViewOut.description: Single round-trip Graph View payload (not nested entity trees).
GraphViewOut.title: GraphViewOut

GraphChannelMutationOut.description: Flat channel snapshot for created/updated buckets (aligned with graph read shape).
GraphChannelMutationOut.title: GraphChannelMutationOut

GraphEdgeMutationOut.description: Edge row; ``id`` is the integer PK (``cf_edge`` has no UUID column).
GraphEdgeMutationOut.title: GraphEdgeMutationOut

GraphNodeMutationOut.description: Flat node snapshot for created/updated buckets (aligned with graph read shape).
GraphNodeMutationOut.title: GraphNodeMutationOut

GraphOutcomeMutationOut.description: Flat outcome snapshot for created/updated buckets (aligned with graph read shape).
GraphOutcomeMutationOut.title: GraphOutcomeMutationOut

GraphSectionMutationOut.description: Flat section snapshot for created/updated buckets (aligned with graph read shape).
GraphSectionMutationOut.title: GraphSectionMutationOut

GraphTagStubOut.description: Placeholder for future tag mutations; buckets remain empty until implemented.
GraphTagStubOut.title: GraphTagStubOut

GraphChannelInsertBelowIn.description: Insert below ``channel_uuid``, or append at end when ``channel_uuid`` is omitted.
GraphChannelInsertBelowIn.title: GraphChannelInsertBelowIn

GraphReorderChannelsIn.description: Full channel order for a graph; every channel on the graph must appear exactly once.
GraphReorderChannelsIn.title: GraphReorderChannelsIn

GraphSectionInsertBelowIn.description: Insert a new section directly below ``section_uuid``; optionally duplicate title.
GraphSectionInsertBelowIn.title: GraphSectionInsertBelowIn

GraphReorderSectionsIn.description: Full section order for a graph; every section on the graph must appear exactly once.
GraphReorderSectionsIn.title: GraphReorderSectionsIn

GraphNodeCreateIn.description: Placement is required on ``Node`` (ORM); optional ``workflow_uuid`` selects a workflow on this graph.
GraphNodeCreateIn.title: GraphNodeCreateIn

GraphNodeInsertBelowIn.description: Insert a node below ``node_uuid``; backend computes grid reflow.
GraphNodeInsertBelowIn.title: GraphNodeInsertBelowIn

GraphNodePlaceIn.description: Place a new node on the grid (sidebar / row drop); backend computes reflow.
GraphNodePlaceIn.title: GraphNodePlaceIn

GraphNodePatchIn.description: Partial update; do not send ``null`` for FK fields (ORM requires section, channel, workflow).
GraphNodePatchIn.title: GraphNodePatchIn

GraphNodeMetaPatchIn.description: Editable node metadata (grid placement and ``node_type`` are not patchable here).
GraphNodeMetaPatchIn.title: GraphNodeMetaPatchIn

GraphNodeLinkWorkflowIn.description: Point a grid node at a library workflow (or clear link back to the graph root workflow).
GraphNodeLinkWorkflowIn.title: GraphNodeLinkWorkflowIn

GraphNodeMoveIn.description: Move an existing node; backend computes sibling row/channel updates.
GraphNodeMoveIn.title: GraphNodeMoveIn

GraphOutcomeMoveIn.description: Reparent and/or reorder among siblings; backend renumbers affected sibling orders.
GraphOutcomeMoveIn.title: GraphOutcomeMoveIn

NotificationListMetaOut.description: List metadata for a paginated inbox (``page`` and ``current_page`` are 1-based).
NotificationListMetaOut.title: NotificationListMetaOut

projectUuid.description: Limit results to workflows whose parent project has this UUID. The project row itself is not included in library results when set.
projectUuid.title: Projectuuid
